description: The bot module (SID_MODULES=bot, with missingHeaders on and internalCookie its_me) and the shared traffic signal, ortb2.device.ext.traffic, which core writes from every source's report. A request whose user agent claims to be a browser but has an empty Accept-Language is a likely bot; the its_me cookie marks internal traffic. The signal describes the traffic, so it's returned with GPC, COPPA and opt-out too. Missing Sec-Fetch-* headers aren't tested here: the runner's HTTP client always sends Sec-Fetch-Mode. Platform verdicts (Cloudflare Bot Management) can't be produced on every target and are covered by unit tests.
